name: com.bertadev.discord-rich-presence
description: Zero-dependency Discord Rich Presence for Unity. Pure C# IPC (no native DLLs), works in the Editor and in Windows, macOS and Linux builds (Mono and IL2CPP). One line to set up, automatic reconnect, rate limiting and a drag-and-drop component.

samples.description: Sets a presence from code and updates it at runtime with on-screen buttons.
